title: Mike Kuster transforms heartache into humor with "Friend Zone"
htmlContent: Maryland country singer Mike Kuster is back at it again with a clever, witty summer anthem for anyone who's ever been almost more than friends in the "Friend Zone." Melding cutting wit with genuine emotion, Kuster turns an age-old heartbreak into pure country gold. The song tells the story of a guy who has everything, including laughs, long nights, shared fandom, and chemistry, except, of course, the actual romance. It's that maddening mix of hope and despair, and Kuster renders it beautifully with humor and heart. https://open.spotify.com/track/0wbv3S3WLFPpW3NYruG7xj Inspired by classic country storytelling, his lyrics are full of charm and swagger, but with a melody that keeps things light and breezy, making them eminently hummable. Kuster's delivery is pure heartland, earnest, identifiable, and warm to the touch. "Friend Zone" is an on-the-radio reminder that sometimes the best stories to be told are the chuckles we share at love gone just slightly tilted. Follow Mike Kuster on Facebook
